intro: iRecover Okanagan is a CARF accredited, abstinence-based drug and alcohol treatment program with locations in Alberta and British Columbia, Canada. The program is designed to offer swift and decisive action, with a rapid access facility that doesn’t require a lengthy wait list or medical referral. The program length ranges from 4 to 12 weeks, and all participants receive personalized care, including 1-on-1 counseling, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, and 12-Step fellowship meetings. In addition, participants are provided with a computer tablet pre-loaded with program content, enabling them to access the four live 12-Step meetings available each day, following their treatment.

pillars.title: Addressing Trauma
pillars.body: The Lavington facility is a 13-bed center that provides an ideal setting for recovery, with stunning views of the mountains. The center employs a unique approach that sees clients work closely alongside their counselors to address a range of physical and emotional challenges, including trauma, health concerns, relationship issues, building self-worth, body image, and identity. The program is designed to create a safe and nurturing environment that promotes lasting recovery and a renewed sense of hope.

pillars.title: Detox First, Then 4 to 12 Weeks of Work
pillars.body: Most people start with medically supervised detox, which iRecover runs before the residential program and prices separately. After that, the days are built around 1-on-1 counselling, cognitive behavioural therapy and group therapy, with 12-Step meetings both in the house and out in the community around Vernon. The program is abstinence-based and runs for 4, 8 or 12 weeks. Because there is no wait list and no doctor referral, someone in the North Okanagan or further afield can usually go from a first phone call to admission quickly.

pillars.title: A Tablet That Goes Home With You
pillars.body: Every participant gets a tablet loaded with the full program content, and it stays with you after discharge. It connects you to four live 12-Step meetings a day and keeps you in touch with the people you went through treatment with, so there is someone to answer to on the hard days. Aftercare is included in the program fee, and the centre also lists aftercare group therapy and alumni get-togethers.

overview: iRecover Okanagan is a renowned rehab center dedicated to helping individuals with substance abuse disorders achieve lifelong recovery. With detox as the starting point, iRecover is designed to provide rapid access to treatment, without the need for doctor referrals or waiting lists, provided the individual has the desire to transform their lives. The facilities have received accreditation and gained a world-class reputation over the past 14 years, transforming the lives of thousands of participants and their families.

iRecover offers a unique approach to addiction treatment using the iRecover program that leverages tablet computers, delivering course materials to individuals during their classroom experience. The qualified and professional staff provides evidence-based treatment in a caring and friendly environment. The program offers specialist addiction treatment in Alberta and British Columbia, with centers located in various parts of Canada. Our commitment to offer a superior quality of safety, confidentiality, respect, and treatment through multiple modalities of addictions recovery informs our approach at iRECOVER TREATMENT CENTERS. After leaving treatment, clients maintain ownership of their tablets, enabling ongoing support and connection with the recovery community.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its recovery.com profile. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does iRecover Okanagan cost?
faqs.a: The 4-week residential program costs $17,000 plus tax and the 8-week program costs $28,000 plus tax. Medically supervised detox is priced separately at $5,200. Aftercare is included once you finish the program. These are the prices on the centre's claimed recovery.com profile, so confirm the current rate and any 12-week price when you call.

faqs.q: How long is the program at iRecover Okanagan?
faqs.a: The residential program runs for 4, 8 or 12 weeks. Many people start with medically supervised detox and then move into the residential program. Your length of stay is set with the intake team.
Yes. iRecover Okanagan offers medically supervised detox, which is priced at $5,200 on its own. Detox is the usual starting point before the residential program begins.

faqs.q: Do I need a referral or have to wait for a bed?
faqs.a: No doctor referral is needed. iRecover describes itself as a rapid access program with no wait list, so you can call the admissions line at 1-877-387-4155 and start the intake yourself. A family member can also call on your behalf.

faqs.q: What types of addictions are treated?
faqs.a: iRecover Okanagan treats all forms of addiction, including drugs and alcohol.

faqs.q: Where is iRecover Okanagan and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 9816 School Road in Lavington, part of the District of Coldstream, about 15 minutes east of Vernon in the North Okanagan. From Vancouver it is roughly 5 hours by car. If you fly, Kelowna International Airport is about 45 minutes away.

Aftercare is included in the program fee. You keep the tablet you used in treatment, loaded with the program content, and it gives you access to four live 12-Step meetings every day. The centre also lists aftercare group therapy, support meetings and alumni get-togethers.

faqs.q: Is iRecover Okanagan private or publicly funded?
faqs.a: iRecover Okanagan is a private, fee-based program. Its recovery.com profile lists private pay as the payment option, and we found no published Interior Health funding for its beds. Some extended health or employee benefit plans cover part of private treatment, so check with your provider.
iRecover Okanagan is licensed by the Ministry of Health in British Columbia.
The program incorporates the 12-Step structure, which has a spiritual component, but it is not religious-based.

faqs.q: What is the age range of participants?
faqs.a: Participants are typically adults, ranging from 18 and older.

faqs.q: Can family and friends visit during treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, family and friends are welcome to visit during designated times throughout the program.
Yes, iRecover Okanagan provides healthy and nutritious meals for participants during their stay.
